cards.title: S2. Cited-answer generator + INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE gate - Dhanush
cards.description:
Sprint 2 · 22–28 Sep 2026

Every answer sentence cites its source chunk, e.g. [dpr:11]. Replies INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when retrieved passages don't cover the question.
Two generation modes:

Extractive (offline): copies the best-matching retrieved sentences. Done, and used for all current results.

Language-model generation: writes the answer from the same passages under the same citation rules. Set up but not yet run (see Blocked).

cards.title: S3. Evaluate all 20 retrieval configurations - Deboprio
cards.description:
Sprint 3 · 29 Sep–5 Oct 2026 (Week 8: evaluation + refinement)

Evaluation run 20260929-074348 UTC (29 Sep 2026, about 17:43 Melbourne time) on corpus 17baac618aa0, k = 5. Results in results/latest.json and results/report.html.

| | Baseline fixed-200/bm25 | Best fixed-400/hybrid+route |
|---|---|---|
| Recall@5 | 0.59 | 0.71 |
| MRR | 0.42 | 0.32 |
| Citation precision | 0.81 | 1.00 |
| Unsupported declined | 6/7 | 7/7 |

cards.title: S3. Analyse retrieval failures - Deboprio
cards.description:
Sprint 3 · 29 Sep–5 Oct 2026

Every failure labelled (retrieval\_miss, wrong\_paper_cited, and others).
Main finding: wrong-paper retrieval. Shared words like "retrieval" and "RAG" outweighed the paper named in the question (e.g. RAG chunks outranked Walert's for a Walert question). Comparison questions often retrieved only one of their two papers.
Other findings: dense (MiniLM) alone weakest (Recall@5 0.35–0.47); bigger chunks inflate recall; remaining misses mostly vocabulary mismatch.

cards.title: S3. Paper-aware routing (+route) - Qiling
cards.description:
Sprint 3 · 29 Sep–5 Oct 2026

retrieval.PaperRouter shares the top-k slots among the papers a question names. Raised citation precision to 1.00 for every chunker; Recall@5 0.59 → 0.71 vs baseline.
Caveat: designed after seeing failures on the same 24 questions, so it needs confirming on a held-out set (see To Do).
